title: Comparative epigenetics of domestic animals: focusing on DNA accessibility and its impact on gene regulation and traits.
one_liner_zh: 综述家养动物染色质可及性及其对基因调控和性状的影响，涉及DNA可及性与调控元件，但未聚焦TF-DNA结合建模，仅提及深度学习工具，方法深度有限。
abstract: IMPORTANCE: Chromatin accessibility is vital for gene regulation, determining the ability of DNA-binding proteins to access the genomic regions and drive transcriptional activity, reflecting environmental changes. Although human and murine studies have advanced the understanding of chromatin dynamics, domestic animals remain comparatively underexplored despite their importance in agriculture and veterinary medicine. Investigating the accessibility of chromatin in these species is crucial for improving traits such as productivity, disease resistance, and environmental adaptation. This review assessed chromatin accessibility research in domestic animals, highlighting its significance in understanding and improving livestock traits. OBSERVATIONS: This review outlines chromatin accessibility research in domestic animals, focusing on critical developmental processes, tissue-specific regulation, and economically significant traits. Advances in techniques, such as Assay for Transposase-Accessible Chromatin using sequencing, have enabled detailed mapping of regulatory elements, shedding light on epigenetic regulation of traits, such as muscle development and productivity. Comparative studies have uncovered conserved and species-specific cis-regulatory elements across multiple species. These findings offer insights into regulatory mechanisms that can enhance breeding strategies and animal management. In addition, high-throughput techniques, such as single-cell analysis and deep-learning models, have advanced the study of chromatin accessibility in lesser-studied species. CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: Chromatin accessibility is crucial in gene regulation in domestic animals, influencing development, immune response, and productivity. Despite the progress, more comprehensive epigenomic datasets and cross-species analytical tools are needed to harness chromatin accessibility in domestic animal research. Understanding these mechanisms has practical applications in improving livestock traits, advancing breeding programs, and developing disease-resistant animals, highlighting the importance of integrating epigenetic and genomic tools for enhancing animal health and productivity.
abstract_zh: 重要性：染色质可及性对于基因调控至关重要，它决定了DNA结合蛋白访问基因组区域并驱动转录活性的能力，反映了环境变化。尽管人类和小鼠研究已推进了对染色质动态的理解，但家养动物在农业和兽医学中具有重要意义，却相对研究不足。研究这些物种的染色质可及性对于改善生产力、抗病性和环境适应等性状至关重要。本综述评估了家养动物中的染色质可及性研究，强调了其在理解和改善牲畜性状中的重要性。观察：本综述概述了家养动物中的染色质可及性研究，重点关注关键发育过程、组织特异性调控和经济重要性状。技术进展，如利用测序的转座酶可及染色质分析 (Assay for Transposase-Accessible Chromatin using sequencing)，已实现对调控元件的详细图谱绘制，揭示了肌肉发育和生产力等性状的表观遗传调控。比较研究已发现多个物种间保守和物种特异性的顺式调控元件。这些发现为增强育种策略和动物管理的调控机制提供了见解。此外，高通量技术，如单细胞分析和深度学习模型，已推进了对研究较少物种中染色质可及性的研究。结论与相关性：染色质可及性在家养动物的基因调控中至关重要，影响发育、免疫反应和生产力的调控。尽管取得了进展，但仍需更全面的表观基因组数据集和跨物种分析工具，以充分利用家养动物研究中的染色质可及性。理解这些机制在改善牲畜性状、推进育种计划和培育抗病动物方面具有实际应用价值，凸显了整合表观遗传和基因组工具以增强动物健康和生产力的重要性。
